note: Husk, zombie, skeleton, stray, wither skeleton, drowned, zombified piglin, vindicator, pillager, evoker. The 64x64 zombie layout with the left limbs on their own texels, (16,48) and (32,48); body pivots at the hips (y 12) and carries the head and arms; arms_folded is the illager pose, kept for idleArms folded: it stands in for both arms with their forearms and hands, which the client hides while it shows. Each limb is jointed (the animation rework rig contract): an upper and a lower 4x6x4 box, the lower on right_forearm, left_forearm, right_shin or left_shin at the elbow or knee, whose faces read the two halves of the vanilla 4x12x4 limb layout; faceuv moves a face to another top-left texel: the top face stays on the upper box, the bottom face on the lower, and each joint cap (the upper box's bottom, the lower box's top) reads the 4 rows of its own front nearest the joint, so a bent joint shows the limb's colour, not a hole. The waist and ankles (animation redo 2026-11, Kort): chest under body at the waist, 6 px above the hips, carries the head, the arms and arms_folded; body keeps the torso's lower 6 rows and chest its upper 6, read from the vanilla 8x12x4 layout the way the limbs read theirs (chest's bottom cap and body's top cap read the 4 rows of their own front nearest the waist, body's bottom stays the vanilla bottom). right_foot and left_foot hang under the shins at the ankle, 4 px below the knee: the shin keeps 4 rows of the limb and the foot the lowest 2, whose caps both read the vanilla sole (a 2-row front cannot hold a 4x4 cap). The troops' own builds (art/hand/common/handlib.py waist_and_ankles) cut their boxes at the same rows, the lower box reaching JOINT_OVERLAP rows past each hinge.
